purpose: Retrain E1 multiclass and E2 binary on identical corrected NF-UNSW memberships and test whether the reported qualitative H1 formulation-sensitivity verdict survives.

claim_boundary.allowed: Corrected-split sensitivity of the reported target- and model-dependent source-label formulation result.
forbidden: Unique causal identification of label semantics.
Selection of whichever historical or corrected result is more favorable.

estimator_parameters.construction: instantiate released estimator classes directly; replace random_state with the run seed; set verbose=false

training.source_preprocessing: original build_preprocessor; fit separately within each pipeline on corrected source train rows only
training.estimator_parameters: construct the corresponding E1 or E2 estimator from data/model_hyperparameters.json and replace random_state with the run seed
training.corrected_validation_role: reported source diagnostic only; no hyperparameter tuning or checkpoint selection
training.MLP_internal_validation: the frozen estimator retains its deterministic internal validation_fraction using the common corrected training rows

evaluation.targets: complete target files, streamed with chunk size 1000000

verdict_policy.delta_definition: E2 minus E1 for the same seed, model, target, and corrected membership
verdict_policy.xgb_primary_gate: For each named target: mean delta Binary-F1 > 0, at least two of three seed deltas Binary-F1 > 0, mean delta MCC > 0, and mean delta FNR < 0.
verdict_policy.rf_reverse_gate: Mean delta Binary-F1 < 0 on each of CICIDS2018, BoT-IoT, and ToN-IoT.
verdict_policy.heterogeneity_gate: Across the nine target-model strata, corrected mean delta Binary-F1 includes at least one positive and one negative value.
verdict_policy.major_sign_reversal: A stratum is a major new counterexample when historical and corrected mean delta Binary-F1 have opposite signs and both absolute values are at least 0.10.
verdict_policy.qualitative_verdict_unchanged: Both XGB primary gates pass, the RF reverse gate passes, the heterogeneity gate passes, and no major sign reversal occurs.
verdict_policy.failure_disposition: If any required gate fails, update H1 and the manuscript rather than selecting the more favorable run.
